title: Intersections of Convex Hulls of Polynomial Shifts and Critical Points
summary: Let $p(z)$ be a complex polynomial of degree $n\ge 2$. For each $c\in\mathbb{C}$, let $K_c$ denote the convex hull of the zeros of $p(z)+c$, and let $K'$ denote the convex hull of the zeros of $p'(z)$. We prove that $$\bigcap_{c\in\mathbb{C}} K_c = K',$$ by combining a strict separating hyperplane argument with a half-plane non-surjectivity theorem for polynomials without critical points (proved via analytic continuation, the monodromy theorem and Liouville's Theorem).
